author: difficulty44_author_c

packet_artifacts.claim: Text names heavy marrow cargo, a heavier DNA wall, no-glucose ferry gating, and team lift/shove.
Visible layout has a TEAM plate, ANY TEAM x2 pad, central separated chamber, floor gap, and exits on the far right.
Idle layout remains stable at 1.5s; no keys were sent.
At 4s speech labels change despite no input, indicating idle presentation is not action feedback.

prior_knowledge.concept: Isp blue and Pac orange pad roles and separate controls; both matching exits goal

evidence.claim: Earlier instructions state pad roles, controls, and two-exit objective.

steps.goal: Use the team-lift/shove route across the chamber and reach both exits.
steps.action: Hypothesis: both heroes stand on the TEAM plate to lift/open the central span; test the ANY TEAM x2 pad as a second activation, then have each hero traverse its own route. Coordinate an apparent ferry only after identifying which hero can power it.
steps.expected_feedback: A team activation should visibly change the central barrier/platform, exposing a safe crossing; the glucose message suggests ferry availability may depend on a resource.

evidence.claim: Prompts hint at team lift/shove and a glucose-dependent ferry.
Visible plates and broken chamber suggest a coordinated platform route.

wrong_turns: Assume either hero alone satisfies TEAM or ANY TEAM x2 without testing the labels.
Jump into the central gap or attempt the far exits before establishing the bridge/ferry state.
unknowns: Activation semantics and duration of both plates, whether the central span is bridge/ferry, which hero can provide glucose, whether the lower region is lethal, actual jump demands, retry cost, and input reliability are not shown.

reasoning.rationale: At least two labels suggest dependencies: team activation and resource-gated transport; their order and relation must be inferred.

evidence.claim: Visible status explicitly mentions team lift/shove and no-glucose ferry policy.

cooperation.rationale: TEAM and x2 labels plus separate exits suggest both heroes contribute to a shared route, but the actual required handoffs remain uncertain.

evidence.claim: The start area visibly labels one plate TEAM and another ANY TEAM x2.

execution.rationale: No movement was observed; the necessary jumps and placements are unknown.

timing.rationale: No moving window is demonstrated by idle images.

hazards.rationale: The gap's consequence and mandatory exposure are unknown.

novelty.rationale: A two-hero lift/shove plus resource-dependent ferry appears to combine cooperation with prior pad concepts; mastery is not established.

evidence.claim: Room text introduces heavy marrow cargo and ferry gating language.

recovery_cost.rationale: No mistake or retry was observed; recovery cannot be estimated.

solution_clarity.rationale: Team and x2 labels give useful clues, while the relationship among heavy cargo, wall, and ferry is only hinted at by jokes/status text.

evidence.claim: Text labels identify pads but do not explain how they open the divided route.

control_friction.rationale: Controls were not used; shared-keyboard reliability is untested.

confidence_reason: The screenshots and instructions support hypotheses about collaboration but reveal no actual route or interactions.
